correctness.rationale: Over uncountable algebraically closed characteristic-zero k, the first orbit image sits in T_1=A_1⊗k[v]. The pinned proof invokes Pham’s localization equality B_1[v^{-1},(v−1)^{-1}]=A_1⊗k[v,v^{-1},(v−1)^{-1}] and the exact projection kernel T_1 v(v−1). Central elements localize to Laurent coefficient ring and PBW intersection forces c∈k[v]. The projection kernel implies c(0)=c(1); conversely each polynomial of this kind differs from a constant by w times a polynomial and belongs to B_1. Independently checked z²−wz−w³=0 for w=v(v−1), z=wv, module decomposition k[w]+z k[w], tangent cone z(z−w), and integral birational normalization via v=z/w; only v=0 and 1 lie over the node.
